rationale: The assistant correctly identified the run-on as a normal cooling fan ('10–30 minutes is quite normal, especially after a hot or long cook'), matching the hidden truth, and gave the right boundary for when it would need attention ('carries on for hours or still runs when the oven is completely cold'). It hedged appropriately ('Probably not broken'), invented nothing, recommended no parts, and reserved engineer referral for the abnormal case only. The only minor gap is that it told the customer what to look for rather than asking whether the fan has ever failed to stop, but the self-check it provided is clear and answerable, so the single-turn conclusion served the homeowner well.
